hero.subtitle: A one day hackathon to build with AI on top of the IOL Inversiones MCP.

terminal.prompt: Using the IOL MCP, set a Take Profit on ASML at 12%
terminal.answer: Done. I set a Take Profit on ASML at 12% above your purchase price.

food.desc: We take care of food all day.

recruiting.desc: They are with you all day and get to know your project.

networking.desc: At the close, with the teams and the organizers.

about.label: The idea
about.statement: You get one day and a team of 3 to build something with AI on top of the IOL MCP, the server that connects an IOL account with Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, OpenCode and other assistants.

summary.title: Portfolio summary
summary.desc: Groups the month's activity and breaks the portfolio down by sector, currency and asset type.

options.title: Options analysis
options.desc: Compares implied volatility, greeks and expirations for the assets in the portfolio.

fixedIncome.title: Fixed income simulator
fixedIncome.desc: Works out what an amount yields in bonds or bills and explains each payment.

exits.title: Automatic exits
exits.desc: Suggests stop losses and take profits from each position's price history.

selection.title: Signing up does not confirm your spot
selection.desc: We review every sign up and university students get priority. If you get in, we email you and send the address then.

team.title: Teams only
team.desc: Teams are 3 people. Individual sign ups are not accepted. Each member signs up with their team code.

punctuality.title: Punctuality
punctuality.desc: Participants who arrive after the agreed time will not be admitted.

cs.desc: ITBA students and alumni, an academic sub-branch of the IEEE Computer Society. We run talks, workshops, courses and hackathons like hackITBA and QuantumJam.

iol.desc: IOL Inversiones is an Argentine online investment platform. As an employer brand, it hires and invests in young people working in tech, and it has sponsored Computer Society ITBA for years.

finalCta.title: Get your team together and sign up

signup.resumed: We saved your progress. Pick up where you left off.

email.title: Sign up
email.desc: We will use this email for all event communications.

personal.title: Personal info
personal.desc: We use it for accreditation and catering.

socials.title: Contact and socials
socials.desc: All optional. It helps sponsors and other participants find you.
